lyrics.ja: こんなにこんなに叶えたいんだ
lyrics.romaji: Konna ni Konna ni Kanaetai n Da
lyrics.en: I want to make it come true so, so much
lyrics.zh: 如此如此地想要實現

lyrics.ja: 強く願って願うだけ夢になった
lyrics.romaji: Tsuyoku Negatte Negau Dake Yume ni Natta
lyrics.en: I wished so hard, and just wishing turned into a dream
lyrics.zh: 強烈地許願，光是許願就化作了夢想

lyrics.ja: そうだからしっかりピッとして マーマレード
lyrics.romaji: Sou Dakara Shikkari Pittoshite Maamareedo
lyrics.en: So that's why—straighten up properly, marmalade
lyrics.zh: 所以啊，好好地打起精神，橘子果醬

lyrics.ja: 私がんばるよ がんばるからね
lyrics.romaji: Watashi Ganbaru yo Ganbaru kara ne
lyrics.en: I'll do my best—I'll keep trying, okay?
lyrics.zh: 我會加油的，我會努力的

lyrics.ja: よっしゃ get up, stand up, run up, grow up, up
lyrics.romaji: Yossha Get Up, Stand Up, Run Up, Grow Up, Up
lyrics.en: Alright—get up, stand up, run up, grow up, up
lyrics.zh: 好耶 get up, stand up, run up, grow up, up

lyrics.ja: 時に満面で 時にチャラけて
lyrics.romaji: Toki ni Manmen de Toki ni Charakete
lyrics.en: Sometimes beaming, sometimes playful
lyrics.zh: 時而滿面笑容，時而嘻皮笑臉

lyrics.ja: 時に凛々しく
lyrics.romaji: Toki ni Ririshiku
lyrics.en: Sometimes dignified
lyrics.zh: 時而凜然帥氣

lyrics.ja: コロコロ変わる空模様みたい
lyrics.romaji: Korokoro Kawaru Sora Moyou Mitai
lyrics.en: Like the ever-changing sky
lyrics.zh: 像千變萬化的天氣

lyrics.ja: どれもちゃんと空だし
lyrics.romaji: Dore mo Chanto Sora Da shi
lyrics.en: Every version is still the sky
lyrics.zh: 不管哪樣，都確確實實是天空

lyrics.ja: 繋ぐ星と星のフレーズ
lyrics.romaji: Tsunagu Hoshi to Hoshi no Fureezu
lyrics.en: Phrases connecting star to star
lyrics.zh: 連繫星星與星星的樂句

lyrics.ja: 私と君のやりとりが線になる
lyrics.romaji: Watashi to Kimi no Yaritori ga Sen ni Naru
lyrics.en: Our exchanges become a line
lyrics.zh: 我與你的互動化成了線

lyrics.ja: 素敵 ロマンチックでドラマチック
lyrics.romaji: Suteki Romanchikku de Doramachikku
lyrics.en: Wonderful, romantic, and dramatic
lyrics.zh: 好美，浪漫又戲劇化

lyrics.ja: 星座になって そして歌になる
lyrics.romaji: Seiza ni Natte Soshite Uta ni Naru
lyrics.en: Becoming a constellation, and then a song
lyrics.zh: 化作星座，然後成為歌曲

lyrics.ja: 日進月歩って言えるほどたくましく
lyrics.romaji: Nisshin Geppo tte Ieru Hodo Takumashiku
lyrics.en: I may not be strong enough to call it steady progress
lyrics.zh: 也許還沒厲害到能說是日新月異

lyrics.ja: できてないかもしれない
lyrics.romaji: Dekitenai Kamo Shirenai
lyrics.en: I might not be there yet
lyrics.zh: 可能還做不到

lyrics.ja: せいぜいトライアンドエラーっていう感じか？
lyrics.romaji: Seizei Torai Ando Eraa tte Iu Kanji ka?
lyrics.en: At best, it's just trial and error, I guess?
lyrics.zh: 頂多就是不斷試錯的感覺吧？

lyrics.ja: I my me (ススメナヤメ カンガエテ)
lyrics.romaji: I My Me (Susume Nayame Kangaete)
lyrics.en: I, my, me (Move forward, worry, think)
lyrics.zh: I my me（前進、煩惱、思考）

lyrics.ja: ねえ、これが私でいいかな？
lyrics.romaji: Nee, Kore ga Watashi de Ii Kana?
lyrics.en: Hey, is it okay for this to be me?
lyrics.zh: 吶，這樣的我也可以嗎？

lyrics.ja: いいでしょ ちょっとやそっとじゃ揺らがないの
lyrics.romaji: Ii Desho Chotto ya Sotto ja Yuraginai no
lyrics.en: It's fine, right? I won't be shaken by just a little
lyrics.zh: 可以吧，才不會因為一點小事動搖

lyrics.ja: こんぐらいは la-ta-la, la-ta-la 笑えちゃうの
lyrics.romaji: Kon Gurai ha La-Ta-La, La-Ta-La Waraechau no
lyrics.en: At least this much—la-ta-la, la-ta-la—I can laugh it off
lyrics.zh: 這種程度 la-ta-la, la-ta-la 一笑置之

lyrics.ja: 笑えたら次に行こう
lyrics.romaji: Waraetara Tsugi ni Ikou
lyrics.en: If I can laugh, let's move on to the next
lyrics.zh: 能笑出來的話，就繼續下一步吧

lyrics.ja: 気づいてる？ちょっと成長してるよ
lyrics.romaji: Kizuiteru? Chotto Seichou Shiteru yo
lyrics.en: Have you noticed? I'm growing a little
lyrics.zh: 發現了嗎？我有一點點成長了喔

lyrics.ja: キュートにキュートに甘いだけじゃなくて
lyrics.romaji: Kyuuto ni Kyuuto ni Amai Dake ja Nakute
lyrics.en: Cute, cute—but not just sweet
lyrics.zh: 可愛、可愛，但不只是甜美

lyrics.ja: ほんのりほんのりほろ苦いの
lyrics.romaji: Honnori Honnori Horonigai no
lyrics.en: Just slightly, slightly bittersweet
lyrics.zh: 還帶著微微、微微的苦澀

lyrics.ja: だって合言葉はピッとして マーマレード
lyrics.romaji: Datte Aikotoba ha Pittoshite Maamareedo
lyrics.en: Because the password is "Straighten up, marmalade"
lyrics.zh: 因為通關密語就是打起精神，橘子果醬

lyrics.ja: 君に会えるまで次は何しよう？
lyrics.romaji: Kimi ni Aeru made Tsugi ha Nani Shiyou?
lyrics.en: Until I can see you, what should I do next?
lyrics.zh: 直到見到你之前，接下來要做什麼呢？

lyrics.ja: よっしゃ get up, stand up, run up, grow up
lyrics.romaji: Yossha Get Up, Stand Up, Run Up, Grow Up
lyrics.en: Alright—get up, stand up, run up, grow up
lyrics.zh: 好耶 get up, stand up, run up, grow up

lyrics.ja: 細部に凝って真心込めて
lyrics.romaji: Saibu ni Kotte Magokoro Komete
lyrics.en: Paying attention to detail, putting my heart into it
lyrics.zh: 講究細節，注入真心

lyrics.ja: 届けたいんだもん
lyrics.romaji: Todoketai n Da Mon
lyrics.en: Because I want to deliver it
lyrics.zh: 因為我就是想傳達出去

lyrics.ja: 一期一会かもしれないけど
lyrics.romaji: Ichigo Ichie Kamo Shirenai kedo
lyrics.en: It might be a once-in-a-lifetime encounter
lyrics.zh: 也許是一期一會

lyrics.ja: 繋がれ、空みたく
lyrics.romaji: Tsunagare, Sora Mitaku
lyrics.en: But connect, like the sky
lyrics.zh: 但如天空般連繫在一起吧

lyrics.ja: どんな服を着て街に出よう
lyrics.romaji: Donna Fuku wo Kite Machi ni Deyou
lyrics.en: What clothes should I wear out into the city?
lyrics.zh: 該穿什麼衣服上街呢

lyrics.ja: どんな髪型を試そう
lyrics.romaji: Donna Kamigata wo Tamesou
lyrics.en: What hairstyle should I try?
lyrics.zh: 該試試什麼髮型呢

lyrics.ja: 一つ一つ君に見てほしいから
lyrics.romaji: Hitotsu Hitotsu Kimi ni Mite Hoshii kara
lyrics.en: Because I want you to see every single one
lyrics.zh: 因為每一樣都想讓你看見

lyrics.ja: ほんとだよ？君はどうだろう？
lyrics.romaji: Honto Da yo? Kimi ha Dou Darou?
lyrics.en: Really, I mean it—what about you?
lyrics.zh: 是真的喔？你呢？

lyrics.ja: もしもが いっぱいいっぱい連なって奇跡が
lyrics.romaji: Moshimo ga Ippai Ippai Tsuranatte Kiseki ga
lyrics.en: If "what ifs" pile up one after another, miracles
lyrics.zh: 如果許許多多的「如果」串連起來，奇蹟

lyrics.ja: いっぱいいっぱい起きちゃって
lyrics.romaji: Ippai Ippai Okichatte
lyrics.en: Will happen again and again
lyrics.zh: 會一個接一個發生

lyrics.ja: 見たことない景色になる
lyrics.romaji: Mita Koto Nai Keshiki ni Naru
lyrics.en: And become a scenery I've never seen
lyrics.zh: 變成前所未見的景色

lyrics.ja: 君と私が作った景色だよ
lyrics.romaji: Kimi to Watashi ga Tsukutta Keshiki Da yo
lyrics.en: A scenery made by you and me
lyrics.zh: 是你和我一起打造的景色喔

lyrics.ja: とってもとっても嬉しいんだ
lyrics.romaji: Tottemo Tottemo Ureshii n Da
lyrics.en: I'm so, so happy
lyrics.zh: 真的真的好開心

lyrics.ja: だからね ほんとにほんとにありがとう、だ
lyrics.romaji: Dakara ne Honto ni Honto ni Arigatou, Da
lyrics.en: So, really, really—thank you
lyrics.zh: 所以啊，真的真的很謝謝你

lyrics.ja: 君がくれるその声でマーマレード
lyrics.romaji: Kimi ga Kureru Sono Koe de Maamareedo
lyrics.en: With that voice you give me—marmalade
lyrics.zh: 用你給我的那個聲音，橘子果醬

lyrics.ja: どんな色にでもなれる
lyrics.romaji: Donna Iro ni demo Nareru
lyrics.en: I can become any color
lyrics.zh: 能變成任何顏色

lyrics.ja: 紅茶に溶かすメロディーや
lyrics.romaji: Koucha ni Tokasu Merodii ya
lyrics.en: A melody that melts into tea
lyrics.zh: 溶進紅茶的旋律

lyrics.ja: 食パンに塗るリズムで
lyrics.romaji: Shokupan ni Nuru Rizumu de
lyrics.en: With a rhythm spread on bread
lyrics.zh: 以塗在吐司上的節奏

lyrics.ja: 楽しさメーターは上がっていく
lyrics.romaji: Tanoshisa Meetaa ha Agatte Iku
lyrics.en: The fun meter keeps rising
lyrics.zh: 快樂指數不斷上升

lyrics.ja: (ススメ ススメ モットユケ)
lyrics.romaji: (Susume Susume Motto Yuke)
lyrics.en: (Move forward, move forward, go further)
lyrics.zh: （前進、前進、再走遠一點）

lyrics.ja: ねえ、だから私は私で
lyrics.romaji: Nee, Dakara Watashi ha Watashi de
lyrics.en: Hey, so I want to be myself
lyrics.zh: 吶，所以我要做我自己

lyrics.ja: いたいの こんなにこんなに叶えたくて
lyrics.romaji: Itai no Konna ni Konna ni Kanaetakute
lyrics.en: I want to be—I want to make it come true so, so much
lyrics.zh: 想保持自我，如此如此地想要實現

lyrics.ja: 強く願って願うだけ夢になって
lyrics.romaji: Tsuyoku Negatte Negau Dake Yume ni Natte
lyrics.en: I wished so hard, and just wishing turned into a dream
lyrics.zh: 強烈地許願，光是許願就化作了夢想

lyrics.ja: なったからね 諦めるはずない
lyrics.romaji: Natta kara ne Akirameru Hazu Nai
lyrics.en: Since it became a dream, there's no way I'll give up
lyrics.zh: 既然已成夢想，就不可能放棄

lyrics.ja: そのステージはきっとそこにある
lyrics.romaji: Sono Suteeji ha Kitto Soko ni Aru
lyrics.en: That stage is surely right there
lyrics.zh: 那個舞台一定就在那裡

lyrics.ja: 一緒に一緒に目指したいの
lyrics.romaji: Issho ni Issho ni Mezashitai no
lyrics.en: I want to aim for it together, together
lyrics.zh: 想一起、一起以它為目標

lyrics.ja: 景色を一緒一緒に作りたいの
lyrics.romaji: Keshiki wo Issho Issho ni Tsukuritai no
lyrics.en: I want to create the scenery together, together
lyrics.zh: 想一起、一起打造景色

lyrics.ja: そうだからしっかりピッとして マーマレード
lyrics.romaji: Sou Dakara Shikkari Pittoshite Maamareedo
lyrics.en: So that's why—straighten up properly, marmalade
lyrics.zh: 所以啊，好好地打起精神，橘子果醬

lyrics.ja: 私がんばるよ がんばるからね
lyrics.romaji: Watashi Ganbaru yo Ganbaru kara ne
lyrics.en: I'll do my best—I'll keep trying, okay?
lyrics.zh: 我會加油的，我會努力的

lyrics.ja: よっしゃ get up, stand up, run up, grow up
lyrics.romaji: Yossha Get Up, Stand Up, Run Up, Grow Up
lyrics.en: Alright—get up, stand up, run up, grow up
lyrics.zh: 好耶 get up, stand up, run up, grow up

lyrics.ja: てな感じで歌っていこう
lyrics.romaji: Te na Kanji de Utatte Ikou
lyrics.en: Let's keep singing like that
lyrics.zh: 就以這種感覺唱下去吧

lyrics.ja: オーオー！オーオー！オーオー！オーオー！
lyrics.romaji: O-O-!O-O-!O-O-!O-O-!
lyrics.en: Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh!
lyrics.zh: Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh!

lyrics.ja: ほんと、ありがとう
lyrics.romaji: Honto, Arigatou
lyrics.en: Really, thank you
lyrics.zh: 真的，謝謝你

lyrics.ja: オーオー！オーオー！オーオー！オーオー！
lyrics.romaji: O-O-!O-O-!O-O-!O-O-!
lyrics.en: Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh!
lyrics.zh: Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh!

lyrics.ja: ずっとね ピッとして マーマレード
lyrics.romaji: Zutto ne Pittoshite Maamareedo
lyrics.en: Forever, straighten up—marmalade
lyrics.zh: 永遠都要打起精神，橘子果醬

lyrics.ja: オーオー！オーオー！オーオー！オーオー！
lyrics.romaji: O-O-!O-O-!O-O-!O-O-!
lyrics.en: Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh!
lyrics.zh: Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh! Oh-Oh!
